settings.subtitle: Support
settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.description: Find answers to common questions about our products, shipping, and policies.
settings.contact_text: Can't find what you're looking for?

settings.question: What makes your products organic?
settings.answer: All our products are formulated with at least 95% certified organic ingredients. We work exclusively with certified organic farms and suppliers, and our products are verified by independent third-party organizations.

settings.question: Are your products suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes! Our formulas are specifically designed to be gentle on all skin types, including sensitive skin. We avoid harsh chemicals, synthetic fragrances, and known irritants. However, we always recommend patch testing any new product.

settings.question: Are your products vegan?
settings.answer: Yes, all our products are 100% vegan and cruelty-free. We never use animal-derived ingredients and we never test on animals. All products are Leaping Bunny certified.

settings.question: How long do your products last once opened?
settings.answer: Most of our products have a 12-month shelf life once opened. Each product displays a Period After Opening (PAO) symbol indicating its specific shelf life. We recommend storing products in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard shipping typically takes 3-5 business days within the continental US. Express shipping (1-2 business days) is available at checkout. International shipping varies by destination, usually 7-14 business days.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes! We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $99 within the United States. International orders may have different thresholds depending on the destination.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship to over 30 countries worldwide. International shipping rates and delivery times vary by destination. You can see the shipping options available for your country at checkout.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If you're not completely happy with your purchase, you can return any unused products for a full refund. Used products may be eligible for store credit.

settings.question: How do I initiate a return?
settings.answer: Simply contact our customer care team at hello@organicskincare.com with your order number. We'll provide you with a prepaid return label and process your refund within 5-7 business days of receiving the return.

settings.question: Can I modify or cancel my order?
settings.answer: You can modify or cancel your order within 1 hour of placing it by contacting us. After that time, we cannot guarantee changes as orders are processed quickly. Contact us immediately if you need to make changes.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number and link. You can also track your order by logging into your account or entering your order number on our Track Order page.

settings.question: Where do you source your ingredients?
settings.answer: We source our ingredients from certified organic farms around the world. Each ingredient is carefully selected for its proven benefits and sustainability. We work directly with farmers to ensure fair trade practices and environmental responsibility.
